item.title: Garmin Opens Aviation Facility At Mesa Gateway Airport
item.description: Garmin announced it has acquired a hangar and office complex at Mesa Gateway Airport in Mesa, Arizona, to expand its capacity for aircraft certification and flight test operations as part of its continued investment in its aviation segment. item.description: MidFirst Bank announced it has expanded its Oklahoma City headquarters campus through the acquisition of a 250,000-square-foot office building adjacent to its existing facilities, reinforcing its long-term growth strategy and deep commitment to its home state of Oklahoma. item.title: Spectrum Networks Acquires New England Cable News Assets
item.description: Spectrum Networks, owned and operated by Charter Communications, announced an agreement with New England Cable News and NBCUniversal to acquire substantially all of NECN’s assets, including its existing distribution agreements throughout New England. item.title: Admiral Group To Acquire Digital Fleet Insurance Platform Flock For £80 Million
item.description: Admiral Group has reached an agreement to acquire Flock, a digital commercial fleet insurance provider known for its telemetry-based proposition, in a deal valuing Flock’s equity at £80 million. The deal remains subject to regulatory approval and is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 2026. item.title: Contents: $7 Million Series B Extension Raised For European AI Work Execution Platform
item.description: Contents, the Milan-based AI work execution platform, has closed a $7 million Series B extension led by Qatar Development Bank, with participation from Alkemia Capital. The investment brings the company’s total funding to $25 million and underscores the growing alignment between European AI infrastructure players and Gulf sovereign innovation strategies.
